excerpt: Students can complete graduate certificates in science and technology or data journalism, or take an individual course from the program. Online Certificate Options Science and Technology Journalism Certificate (8 credits) - JOUR 471: Science Journalism (3 credits) - JOUR 460 (HSV): Humanizing Science through Video Storytelling (4 credits) - JOUR 460 (ING): Journalists’ Guide to Genomics (1 credit) Data Journalism Certificate (8 credits) - JOUR 460 (BDJ): Basics of Data Journalism (4 credits) - JOUR 460 (DVJ): Data Visualization (4 credits) Individual Course Options Journalists and other professional communicators who want to boost their skills are welcome to enroll in online course modules as non-degree students.
